description: How fresh POAScan's data is and whether its totals agree with the node: last good read per upstream endpoint, live-feed state, node staleness, the header pill state, a maintenance block (active only during staged network maintenance; phase complete with completed_at once it is officially over; paused and working lists, the official post, and answers and seals seen in the last hour), and a reconciliation of POAScan's totals against the node's own numbers (mined, burned, held, holders, Agents, closes, height, checkpoint, txs, pending) with both values, the difference, a state, a reason and when each side was read. Use it before trusting a number, when the node or POAScan looks stale, or to check what is working.

reconcile.description: include the reconciliation block (default true); false returns freshness only
